buildMachine.description: Selects a custom build machine for this deployment without changing project settings.

customEnvironmentSlugOrId.description: The slug or ID of a custom environment to deploy to, overriding the default target environment. When omitted, the deployment targets the environment inferred from the branch (production or preview).

deploymentId.description: The ID of an existing deployment to redeploy. All project settings and environment variables are inherited from the original unless explicitly overridden in this request. The redeployment gets a new ID, URL, and build.

files.description: The files to include in the deployment. Each entry is either an inlined file (with `data` and `encoding`) or a reference to a previously uploaded file (with `sha` and `size`). Required for non-git deployments. Cannot be used together with `gitSource`.

oneOf.description: Used in the case you want to inline a file inside the request

data.description: The file content, it could be either a `base64` (useful for images, etc.) of the files or the plain content for source code

encoding.description: The file content encoding, it could be either a base64 (useful for images, etc.) of the files or the plain text for source code.

file.description: The file name including the whole path

oneOf.title: InlinedFile

oneOf.description: Used in the case you want to reference a file that was already uploaded

file.description: The file path relative to the project root

sha.description: The file contents hashed with SHA1, used to check the integrity

oneOf.title: UploadedFile

gitAccessToken.description: Available only to Vercel platform accounts. A read-only GitHub access token scoped to the requested repository. Use a token with a lifetime of 24 hours or less that remains valid until source retrieval completes.

gitMetadata.description: Populates initial git metadata for different git providers.

remoteUrl.description: The git repository's remote origin url

commitAuthorName.description: The name of the author of the commit

commitAuthorEmail.description: The email of the author of the commit

commitMessage.example: add method to measure Interaction to Next Paint (INP) (#36490)

commitRef.description: The branch on which the commit was made

dirty.description: Whether or not there have been modifications to the working tree since the latest commit

ci.description: True if process.env.CI was set when deploying

ciType.description: The type of CI system used

ciGitProviderUsername.description: The username used for the Git Provider (e.g. GitHub) if their CI (e.g. GitHub Actions) was used, if available

ciGitRepoVisibility.description: The visibility of the Git repository if their CI (e.g. GitHub Actions) was used, if available

rootDirectory.description: Path of the deployed directory relative to the detected git repository root. Empty string when deploying from the repository root.

gitSource.description: Defines the Git Repository source to be deployed. This property can not be used in combination with `files`.

repoId.description: The stable Vercel Git repository ID.

anyOf.description: Deploys from the Cursor Origin repository linked to the target project. The repository ID must match the linked repository; Vercel resolves the owner and repository name from the project link.

owner.description: The Origin workspace slug. Optional because Vercel resolves it from the linked project.

ref.description: The branch or Git reference to deploy.

repo.description: The Origin repository name. Optional because Vercel resolves it from the linked project.

repoId.description: The stable Origin repository ID. Read it from the `link.repoId` field returned by the project API.

sha.description: The commit SHA to deploy. When omitted, Vercel resolves the latest commit on `ref`.

meta.description: An object containing the deployment's metadata. Multiple key-value pairs can be attached to a deployment. For deployments created with a Cursor Origin `gitSource`, Vercel automatically adds `cursorOriginDeployment`, `cursorOriginCommitSha`, `cursorOriginCommitRef`, `cursorOriginCommitMessage`, `cursorOriginCommitAuthorName`, `cursorOriginCommitAuthorEmail` when available, `cursorOriginOwner`, `cursorOriginRepo`, `cursorOriginRepoId`, and `cursorOriginPrId` for pull request deployments.

monorepoManager.description: The monorepo manager that is being used for this deployment. When `null` is used no monorepo manager is selected

name.description: A string with the project name used in the deployment URL

project.description: The target project identifier in which the deployment will be created. When defined, this parameter overrides name

projectSettings.description: Project settings that will be applied to the deployment. It is required for the first deployment of a project and will be saved for any following deployments

buildCommand.description: The build command for this project. When `null` is used this value will be automatically detected

devCommand.description: The dev command for this project. When `null` is used this value will be automatically detected

framework.description: The framework that is being used for this project. When `null` is used no framework is selected

installCommand.description: The install command for this project. When `null` is used this value will be automatically detected

nodeVersion.description: Override the Node.js version that should be used for this deployment

outputDirectory.description: The output directory of the project. When `null` is used this value will be automatically detected

rootDirectory.description: The name of a directory or relative path to the source code of your project. When `null` is used it will default to the project root

serverlessFunctionRegion.description: The region to deploy Serverless Functions in this project

skipGitConnectDuringLink.description: Opts-out of the message prompting a CLI user to connect a Git repository in `vercel link`.

sourceFilesOutsideRootDirectory.description: Indicates if there are source files outside of the root directory, typically used for monorepos

target.description: Either not defined, `staging`, `production`, or a custom environment identifier. If `staging`, a staging alias in the format `<project>-<team>.vercel.app` will be assigned. If `production`, any aliases defined in `alias` will be assigned. If omitted, the target will be `preview`.

withLatestCommit.description: When `true` and `deploymentId` is passed in, the sha from the previous deployment's `gitSource` is removed forcing the latest commit to be used.
